title: Check that every declared rebuildable work schema object is work-owned, and tie the projection-repair test to the readiness verdict
outcome: Check that every declared rebuildable work schema object is work-owned, and tie the projection-repair test to the readiness verdict
acceptance: A storage test asserts, for every entry of REBUILDABLE_WORK_SCHEMA_OBJECTS read at run time, that owns_schema_object claims its name, so a declared rebuildable object can never be classified as a durable core object
The projection-repair recovery test asserts store_open_refusal_kind(&error) == StoreOpenRefusalKind::ProjectionRepairRequired instead of only matching message text
